jei.miscelanea.info.fogon: Drop the ingredients into the pan with right click, in any order. When the mix is a recipe it cooks by itself for a few seconds; take the dish out with right click. If the recipe can still be extended (paella with cod), it waits a bit in case you add the rest.

jei.miscelanea.info.algodonera: Give it sugar with right click and it drops a cotton candy. A pink, light blue, white, yellow or lime dye changes the color.

jei.miscelanea.info.ficha: The fair and arcade currency: pay with right click on stalls and machines.
jei.miscelanea.info.tinte_arma: Put it in a crafting table with a dye to change its color (it keeps everything else).
jei.miscelanea.info.bichopedia: Bugs spawn around players depending on biome, time and weather. Catch them with the net (or fish with the rod) and log them in the Bugpedia.
jei.miscelanea.info.trampa_oso: Put it on the head of someone nearby (right click; on yourself, sneak + right click in the air). One of the Jigsaw boxes within 32 blocks holds the key: searching them is a minigame. With no boxes nearby there is more time and the key goes to one placed later. With the key, right click to take it off. When time runs out... it snaps.
jei.miscelanea.info.gancho: Hang someone upside down with right click. After a while the blood rushing to the head starts to hurt. The victim can try to break free by jumping.
jei.miscelanea.info.caja_agua: Needs a water tank nearby. Put the box on someone and pull the tank's lever: the water rises. The victim can only drain it by pushing their hands into the blades ("Push hands in" key).

jei.miscelanea.info.caldero_mezclas: Mixing Cauldron: right click with a potion to pour it in (you get the bottle back); up to 4 fit. The liquid changes colour with each one. Use an empty bottle to take out a mixed flask with ALL the effects together: you get as many flasks as potions you poured. The more effects, the shorter each lasts (x1, x0.8, x0.65, x0.5); a repeated effect keeps the strongest. Gunpowder: flasks come out as splash. Sneak with an empty hand: empty it.
jei.miscelanea.info.frasco_mezcla: Filled at the Mixing Cauldron and carries several effects at once. The splash version (mix with gunpowder) splashes all of its effects when it breaks.
jei.miscelanea.info.esencia_dream: Creative only. Gives Venomous Bite for 5 minutes: with an empty hand, right click a player or mob to grab them and bite every 1.5 s. The venom works like a Komodo dragon's drool: it paralyses (Slowness rising with each bite, up to III), dizzies (Nausea), bleeds (Bleeding, with neck wounds) and weakens. The victim breaks free with a struggle minigame; the biter lets go by sneaking or when hit hard. Sneaking with an empty bottle extracts Dream's Venom (then no venom or bites for 5 minutes). It can also be poured into the Mixing Cauldron.
jei.miscelanea.info.anillo_medianoche: Creative only. Hold right click for 3 seconds to travel to The Midnight dimension; there, use it again to return to where you left. Requires The Midnight mod (the dimension can be changed in the server config).

jei.miscelanea.info.muestra_glitch: Creative only. A living sample of "the glitch". If dropped (Q, taking it out of the inventory...) it shakes and hisses for a second and a half and breaks; if burned or blown up, instantly. Right click: thrown like a splash potion, breaking on impact. When it breaks, a sphere of corruption grows from there: blocks glitch and vanish, dropped items are deleted and living things get nausea, darkness and a bit of damage. The radius and whether blocks are destroyed are set in the server config.
jei.miscelanea.info.frasco_muestras: Creative only. Right click a corrupted block (from the Error Core or a glitch wave), someone with the Glitch effect or inside a wave that's still alive: it fills with a glitch sample. The block it's taken from comes apart.

jei.miscelanea.info.veneno_dream: Only obtainable with Venomous Bite active: sneak and right click with an empty bottle to extract the venom from your fangs. Afterwards you run out of venom for a while (5 minutes by default): you can neither extract again nor bite. LETHAL IF DRUNK: whoever drinks it coughs, clutches their throat, falls to their knees convulsing and dies face down (holding a Totem of Undying, the totem saves them; it does not kill in creative). It can be poured into the Mixing Cauldron: drinkable flasks from that mix are lethal too, but throwable ones only splash Slowness II, Nausea, Bleeding and Weakness for a few seconds.
